🚀 Quick Start — Do These First

Your "Me" player card in Manage My Players

A handful of one-time settings make every round faster and more accurate. Find all of these in ⚙️ Manage My Players:

  • Set yourself as "Me" — auto-fills you as Player 1 every round and unlocks Home City and Home Course settings.
  • Set your Home City — drives live weather on the Setup screen.
  • Set your Home Course — appears first in the course picker, auto-selected every new round.
  • Set your preferred tee — maps to the closest-matching tee at every other course automatically.
  • Star your regular players and set each player's Score Wheel Default (Par, Bogey, or Double).
  • Tap 🔄 Refresh All Handicaps to pull all Golf Canada indexes at once.
💡Don't be surprised to see dozens of names already in Manage My Players — a starter roster ships with the app and merges safely. It never overwrites anyone you've already saved.
—

Privacy & Data Security

All round data, player names, handicaps, betting results, and Golf Canada member IDs are stored exclusively in your iPhone's browser storage (localStorage). This data never leaves your device.

Your Golf Canada credentials are used only to fetch your current handicap index — stored only on your device, never transmitted to anyone other than Golf Canada's own secure API.

📌Pards Golf does not collect analytics, does not serve ads, has no user accounts, and has no server. Your data is yours alone.
1

Installing Pards Golf on Your iPhone

Pards Golf is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your Home Screen from Safari — not the App Store.

⚠️You MUST install to your Home Screen before your data will be reliably saved.
⚠️Do NOT use "Remove App" on the Home Screen icon — this permanently wipes all local data.

Step-by-Step

1
Open Safari on your iPhone.
2
Go to: https://bdcomeau.github.io/pardsgolf/pards-golf.html
3
Tap the Share button — square with arrow pointing up, bottom toolbar.
4
Tap "Add to Home Screen."
5
Tap "Add" in the top-right corner.
6
Always launch from the Home Screen icon — not a Safari bookmark.
💡Keeping current: Tap Update App in the bottom action bar. If still outdated, clear Safari site data for bdcomeau.github.io (Settings → Safari → Advanced → Website Data).

Setting Up a Round

Course Picker

Tap the course button at top. Your Home Course always appears first. Courses are organised into Canada and USA region accordions — tap any region to expand it.

💡Tap 📋 Info on any course row for live weather, your round history, and the full 18-hole scorecard.

Players & Starting Hole

Use + and − to set 1–5 players. Tap ⭐ Load My Favourites to fill your regular group. Change the starting hole for shotgun starts.

Reset Round Setup
Number of Players & Starting Hole

Round Options

Toggle Scorekeeping Mode Only to disable all betting games, or enable Birdie Juice Tracking — works in both Games and Scores Only mode.

Loading Players

⭐ Load My Favourites fills your regular group automatically. ⚙️ Manage My Players opens the full roster to add, edit, or configure contacts.

Player Tab Bar & Player Card

One tab per player — tap to switch between players. Each card shows name, handicap index, Golf Canada ID, tee selection, and lifetime balance. Tap Fetch to pull the latest handicap from Golf Canada.

💡Player card format never changes — tabs only show/hide the cards.
Start Round banner

Once all players are set and games configured, tap the gold Start Round → banner to begin.

The Course Picker

Course List
Course Scorecard & Info

Course List

Canada and USA region accordions with provincial/state flag icons. Your Home Course is pinned at top with a gold ✓. Search any course by name.

💡Every course row shows its own live weather independently. Edmonton-area courses share one efficient call; all others fetch in background batches.

Manage My Players

Tap ⚙️ Manage My Players on the Setup screen. Search bar floats at the bottom. Players sorted: "Me" first → ⭐ Favourites → alphabetically. A–Z rail on the right edge.

  • ⭐ Star — mark as Favourite for auto-fill
  • Index — current handicap (red arrow = recently changed)
  • Golf Canada ID — with COPY button
  • Tee Deck — preferred tee, remembered per course per player
  • Score Wheel Default — Par, Bogey, or Double
  • Home City / Home Course — "Me" entry only
Refresh All Handicaps
💡Tap 🔄 Refresh All Handicaps to pull every saved player's current index from Golf Canada in one batch.
14

Scoring — The Scorecard Screen

Entering Scores
Scores Confirmed

Scroll each player's wheel to their score. The selected score highlights in gold — tap it to confirm, or tap the gold "✓ Confirm & Next Hole →" button. Running money shows in each player header once scores are confirmed. Correct any score by scrolling again — everything recalculates instantly.

✨Confirm Scores is always ON — auto-advance has been permanently removed. Every hole requires an explicit tap.

Live Standings & Who Strokes

Live Standings
Who Strokes

Tap the LIVE STANDINGS and WHO STROKES? bars at the bottom of the scorecard to expand live game totals and handicap stroke details for the current hole.

The Round Bar & ☰ Menu

During a round, the slim gold bar at the bottom replaces the full nav. Tap it to return to the scorecard. Tap ☰ Menu to open:

  • Return to Scorecard
  • Games — all betting game screens
  • Birdie Juice — credits and tracker
  • Round History — view past rounds
  • Mid-Round Settings
  • Save & End Round

Mid-Round Settings

Settings Menu
Players & Tees

Access via ☰ Menu → Mid-Round Settings. Tap any header to expand. Change handicaps, switch tee boxes, add/remove players, or adjust any betting game mid-round.

Change Starting Hole

Change Starting Hole shifts all scores already entered to their correct new positions. All matches recalculate automatically.

Ending a Round Early

Tap ☰ Menu → Save & End Round. Two choices:

  • Save & Pause Round — saves to History, resumable anytime. Hold 2 seconds to confirm.
  • Hold to Abandon Round — discards entirely, no record saved.
Round Complete banner

Completing a Round

On hole 18 the confirm button becomes "✓ Complete Round 🏆". Tapping it saves immediately and shows the gold completion banner:

  • 👇 Start New Round — begin a fresh round
  • 📜 View & Share Results — navigates directly to History and auto-opens your completed round. Live round is fully retired so Match Cards and history editing work immediately.

Nassau Games

2v2 Nassau
1v1 Nassau

2v2 Nassau (High-Low)

Two teams of two. Each team contributes their Low ball and High ball net score. Tap a matchup card to add it, set the side bet. A gold ✓ next to a player shows whose score "counted" — visible on screen and in all exports.

1v1 Nassau

One player vs another, running as a standard Nassau (Front 9 / Back 9 / Total). Multiple matchups run simultaneously.

Auto-Press

When a game reaches −2 margin, a press automatically starts from the next hole. Presses can be pressed. Full press history shown in the Games tab during the round.

The International (The Big I)

Call The International
Outcome Table

Available after Hole 17 to the losing team. A full-screen prompt fires automatically before Hole 18. The outcome table shows exactly what each Hole 18 result means — called vs not called.

  • Losing team wins Hole 18 → pot voided
  • Leading team wins → pot doubles
  • Halved → pot stays as-is
International Called confirmation

Once called, tap Undo if called by mistake before scoring Hole 18.

6

The 6-Point Game

Three-player game. Each hole: low net wins 4 pts, second wins 2, third wins 0. Ties for low give 3 pts each. Points convert to dollars at round end.

Tap any three-player combination card to select it, then set the dollar value per point. Multiple 3-player groups can run simultaneously.

💡With 5 players, all possible 3-player combinations appear as selectable cards.
7

Stableford

Individual points game. Full handicap applied. Highest points total wins — loser pays winner the points difference × bet. Select players, set bet per point.

Albatross6
Eagle5
Birdie3

✨Points values are adjustable with + / −. Tap "Reset to defaults" to restore standard values.
8

Skins

Each hole is its own contest. Win the hole outright → take the skin. Tie → skin carries to next hole, building a pot.

  • Players: tap names to include/exclude
  • Value per skin: $1 · $2 · $5 · $10 · $20
  • Scoring: Net (handicap) or Gross
  • On a tie: Carry over or No carry
  • After 18: Wash (void) or Last hole takes all
✨With five players at $5/skin, three carried skins on one hole = $15 to the winner.
9

Vegas

Fixed 2-vs-2. Each team's scores combine low digit first — a 4 and 5 becomes 45. Teams play the difference each hole × the dollar value.

The Flip: opponent birdie flips your number high-first: 45 → 54. Brutal.

  • Dollar per point: 25¢ · 50¢ · $1 · $2 · $5
  • Scoring: Gross or Net (handicap)
  • Flip: on (default) or off
⚠️Requires exactly 4 players. With 5 players, choose which four compete in each pairing.
10

The Snake 3-Putt Money Game

Whoever holds the snake (last person to 3-putt) after holes 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18 pays each other participant the wager. The snake resets after each settlement hole.

3-putts are tracked hole-by-hole on the scorecard. Enable in the SNAKE tab, set bet per player, select participants.

💡The green dot on the SNAKE tab confirms it's enabled.
11

Match Cards

Play 1v1 Nassau against golfers in other groups. Your scores are tracked live during your round — opponents' scores entered later from History.

  • Enable Match Cards with the checkbox
  • Select or type Opponent 1 (up to 2 opponents)
  • Set their handicap index and tee
  • Set Nassau bet per side (F9 / B9 / 18)

When your round finishes, a separate ⚔️ Match Cards round is saved to History with a purple border and Score Round button.

Match Cards entry in History — tap Score Round to enter opponents' scores
✨Tap 📜 View & Share Results after your round to go straight to History, then tap the Match Cards entry to score opponents.

Round History

History List
Round Detail & Final Totals

Access via ☰ Menu → Round History during a round, or the History tab at setup. Tap any round to open the full detail view — Final Totals, Master Scorecard with all scores, and Share / Print options.

Backup & Restore

Tap 💾 Backup / Data in the bottom action bar.

  • 📤 Export — saves to Files, iCloud, or email
  • 📥 Import — restores from a previously exported file
⚠️Export a backup regularly. iOS can wipe PWA storage when you remove the Home Screen icon or run low on storage.

Troubleshooting

ProblemSolution
My round disappeared 🏌️Use 💾 Save & Pause Round before ending early. Without saving, data cannot be recovered.
App looks outdated 🤔Tap Update App. If still outdated, clear Safari site data for bdcomeau.github.io, force-close, reopen.
Pop-ups aren't appearing 😶Run from the Home Screen icon — not a Safari tab.
Player data disappeared 😱"Remove App" wipes all data. Restore from a backup file if available.
Player left mid-round 🚑☰ Menu → Mid-Round Settings → remove them there.
Weather not showing 🌦️Loads in background after launch. Wait a moment and reopen the picker.
Handicap strokes wrong ✏️Formula: Index × (Slope ÷ 113) + (Course Rating − Par), rounded to nearest whole number.
History lock not working 🔒Hold for the full 2 seconds without moving your finger — icon fades as you hold.
Confirm button not appearing 🤔Once all players have a score, the gold Confirm & Next Hole button appears at the bottom.
"Active Round in Progress" 🚫Fixed in v20.33. If it appears, use ☰ Menu → Save & End Round first, then retry.
